newsitem.title: USA: Wal-Mart June same-store sales up 6.4 pct.
newsitem.headline: Wal-Mart June same-store sales up 6.4 pct.

text.p: Wal-Mart Stores Inc, the largest retailer in the U.S., said Thursday its same store sales in June rose 6.4 percent from the comparable period a year ago.
Total sales for the five weeks to July 4, 1997 rose 11.8 percent from the same period last year to $11.15 billion from $9.98 billion in the prior year.
Same store sales for the 22-week period to July 4, 1997 rose 6.0 percent from the comparable period a year ago, the retailer said.
Total sales for the 22-week period were $45.85 billion, an increase of 11.8 percent from the $41.00 billion in the similar period in the prior year.

Sam's Clubs sales for the five week period were $2.0 billion, up 3.4 percent from sales of $1.95 billion in the prior year period. Club sales for the 22-weeks of $8.32 billion were up 4.3 percent from the $7.98 billion in the similar prior year period.

As of June 30, 1997, the company had 1,939 Wal-Mart stores, 374 Supercenters, 441 Sam's Clubs, six Argentina units, five Brazilian units, 137 Canadian Wal-Mart stores, two China stores, two Indonesian Supercenters, 153 Mexican units, and 11 Puerto Rico units.
